title: How does the stock market work? - Oliver Elfenbaum
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】股票市場如何運作？ ——奧利佛‧埃爾芬鮑姆（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: In the 1600s the Dutch East India Company employed hundreds of ships
cues.en: In the 1600s the Dutch East India Company employed hundreds of ships
cues.zh: 在 1600 年代， 荷蘭東印度公司僱用了數百艘船，

cues.text: to trade gold, porcelain, spices, and silks around the globe.
cues.en: to trade gold, porcelain, spices, and silks around the globe.
cues.zh: 做黃金、瓷器、香料， 和絲的全球貿易。

cues.text: But running this massive operation wasn’t cheap.
cues.en: But running this massive operation wasn’t cheap.
cues.zh: 但要支撐這麼龐大的營運， 花費一點也不便宜。

cues.text: In order to fund their expensive voyages, the company turned to private citizens–
cues.en: In order to fund their expensive voyages, the company turned to private citizens–
cues.zh: 但要支撐這麼龐大的營運， 花費一點也不便宜。 為了要資助這些昂貴的航程， 該公司轉向平民——

cues.text: individuals who could invest money to support the trip in exchange for a share of the ship’s profits.
cues.en: individuals who could invest money to support the trip in exchange for a share of the ship’s profits.
cues.zh: 去找有錢能夠拿來投資、 資助旅程的個體戶， 交換條件則是可以分到 該船賺得的利潤。

cues.text: This practice allowed the company to afford even grander voyages,
cues.en: This practice allowed the company to afford even grander voyages,
cues.zh: 這種做法，讓該公司能夠 負擔得起更浩大的航程， 讓公司本身及精明的投資者 都獲得更高的利潤。

cues.text: increasing profits for both themselves and their savvy investors.
cues.en: increasing profits for both themselves and their savvy investors.
cues.zh: 讓公司本身及精明的投資者 都獲得更高的利潤。 荷蘭東印度公司在各大陸的

cues.text: Selling these shares in coffee houses and shipping ports across the continent,
cues.en: Selling these shares in coffee houses and shipping ports across the continent,
cues.zh: 荷蘭東印度公司在各大陸的 咖啡館及海港銷售這些股份，

cues.text: the Dutch East India Company unknowingly invented the world’s first stock market.
cues.en: the Dutch East India Company unknowingly invented the world’s first stock market.
cues.zh: 咖啡館及海港銷售這些股份， 不知不覺間，發明瞭 全世界第一個股票市場。

cues.text: Since then, companies have been collecting funds from willing investors
cues.en: Since then, companies have been collecting funds from willing investors
cues.zh: 自此之後，公司便會向 有意願的投資者募款，

cues.text: to support all kinds of businesses.
cues.en: to support all kinds of businesses.
cues.zh: 來資助各式各樣的生意。

cues.text: And today, the stock market has schools, careers, and even whole television channels
cues.en: And today, the stock market has schools, careers, and even whole television channels
cues.zh: 來資助各式各樣的生意。 現今，還有專門的學校、 職業，甚至專用的電影片道 來研究瞭解股票市場。

cues.text: dedicated to understanding it.
cues.en: dedicated to understanding it.
cues.zh: 來研究瞭解股票市場。

cues.text: But the modern stock market is significantly more complicated
cues.en: But the modern stock market is significantly more complicated
cues.zh: 但，現代股票市場遠比 它的原始型態更複雜許多。

cues.text: than its original incarnation.
cues.en: than its original incarnation.
cues.zh: 它的原始型態更複雜許多。 所以，現今公司和投資者 怎麼運用這個市場？

cues.text: So how do companies and investors use the market today?
cues.en: So how do companies and investors use the market today?
cues.zh: 所以，現今公司和投資者 怎麼運用這個市場？ 咱們來想像一間新的咖啡公司， 決心要進入市場。

cues.text: Let’s imagine a new coffee company that decides to launch on the market.
cues.en: Let’s imagine a new coffee company that decides to launch on the market.
cues.zh: 咱們來想像一間新的咖啡公司， 決心要進入市場。 首先，該公司會為自己打廣告， 物件是大型投資者。

cues.text: First, the company will advertise itself to big investors.
cues.en: First, the company will advertise itself to big investors.
cues.zh: 首先，該公司會為自己打廣告， 物件是大型投資者。 如果他們認為 這個公司是個好點子，

cues.text: If they think the company is a good idea, they get the first crack at investing,
cues.en: If they think the company is a good idea, they get the first crack at investing,
cues.zh: 如果他們認為 這個公司是個好點子， 他們就能取得投資的先機， 接著，贊助該公司的 初次公開發行（IPO）。

cues.text: and then sponsor the company’s initial public offering, or IPO.
cues.en: and then sponsor the company’s initial public offering, or IPO.
cues.zh: 接著，贊助該公司的 初次公開發行（IPO）。

cues.text: This launches the company onto the official public market, where any company or individual who believes the business could be profitable
cues.en: This launches the company onto the official public market, where any company or individual who believes the business could be profitable
cues.zh: 這就能讓該公司進入到 正式的公開市場， 在這裡，相信這事業 有利可圖的任何公司或個體戶

cues.text: might buy a stock.
cues.en: might buy a stock.
cues.zh: 在這裡，相信這事業 有利可圖的任何公司或個體戶 都可以買股票。

cues.text: Buying stocks makes those investors partial owners in the business.
cues.en: Buying stocks makes those investors partial owners in the business.
cues.zh: 都可以買股票。 投資者購買股票之後， 便擁有該事業的一部分。

cues.text: Their investment helps the company to grow, and as it becomes more successful,
cues.en: Their investment helps the company to grow, and as it becomes more successful,
cues.zh: 他們的投資，協助該公司成長， 當該公司更成功之後，

cues.text: more buyers may see potential and start buying stocks.
cues.en: more buyers may see potential and start buying stocks.
cues.zh: 可能會有更多的買家 看到潛力，也開始買股票。

cues.text: As demand for those stocks increases, so does their price, increasing the cost for prospective buyers,
cues.en: As demand for those stocks increases, so does their price, increasing the cost for prospective buyers,
cues.zh: 隨著對那些股票的需求增加， 股票的價格也會提高， 增加未來買家的成本，

cues.text: and raising the value of the company's stocks people already own.
cues.en: and raising the value of the company's stocks people already own.
cues.zh: 已經擁有該公司股票的人， 手上股票的價值也會提升。

cues.text: For the company, this increased interest helps fund new initiatives,
cues.en: For the company, this increased interest helps fund new initiatives,
cues.zh: 對該公司來說，增加的股份 能協助資助新的計畫， 同時，因為展現出 有這麼多人願意投資該公司，

cues.text: and also boosts its overall market value by showing how many people are willing to invest in their idea.
cues.en: and also boosts its overall market value by showing how many people are willing to invest in their idea.
cues.zh: 同時，因為展現出 有這麼多人願意投資該公司， 也能夠抬高該公司的 整體市場價值。

cues.text: However, if for some reason a company starts to seem less profitable
cues.en: However, if for some reason a company starts to seem less profitable
cues.zh: 然而，如果出於某種原因， 公司看起來不再那麼有利可圖時，

cues.text: the reverse can also happen.
cues.en: the reverse can also happen.
cues.zh: 就可能會發生相反的狀況。

cues.text: If investors think their stock value is going to decline, they’ll sell their stocks with the hopes of making a profit
cues.en: If investors think their stock value is going to decline, they’ll sell their stocks with the hopes of making a profit
cues.zh: 如果投資者認為他們的 股票價值有下跌的趨勢， 他們就會賣掉股票， 希望能在該公司失去 更多價值前就先賺回些利潤。

cues.text: before the company loses more value.
cues.en: before the company loses more value.
cues.zh: 希望能在該公司失去 更多價值前就先賺回些利潤。

cues.text: As stocks are sold and demand for the stock goes down, the stock price falls,
cues.en: As stocks are sold and demand for the stock goes down, the stock price falls,
cues.zh: 希望能在該公司失去 更多價值前就先賺回些利潤。 當股票被賣出， 且對股票的需求減少， 股價就會下跌，

cues.text: and with it, the company’s market value.
cues.en: and with it, the company’s market value.
cues.zh: 股價就會下跌， 公司的市場價值也會跟著下跌。

cues.text: This can leave investors with big losses– unless the company starts to look profitable again.
cues.en: This can leave investors with big losses– unless the company starts to look profitable again.
cues.zh: 公司的市場價值也會跟著下跌。 這可能會造成投資者極大的損失—— 除非該公司能夠再次開始獲利。

cues.text: This see-saw of supply and demand is influenced by many factors.
cues.en: This see-saw of supply and demand is influenced by many factors.
cues.zh: 會影響這種供給需求 蹺蹺板的因素很多。

cues.text: Companies are under the unavoidable influence of market forces–
cues.en: Companies are under the unavoidable influence of market forces–
cues.zh: 會影響這種供給需求 蹺蹺板的因素很多。 無可避免，公司一定會 受到市場力量的影響—— 比如原料價格的波動、

cues.text: such as the fluctuating price of materials, changes in production technology,
cues.en: such as the fluctuating price of materials, changes in production technology,
cues.zh: 比如原料價格的波動、 生產技術的改變， 以及勞工成本的變動。

cues.text: and the shifting costs of labor.
cues.en: and the shifting costs of labor.
cues.zh: 以及勞工成本的變動。 投資者可能會擔心 領導階層的改變、

cues.text: Investors may be worried about changes in leadership, bad publicity, or larger factors like new laws and trade policies.
cues.en: Investors may be worried about changes in leadership, bad publicity, or larger factors like new laws and trade policies.
cues.zh: 投資者可能會擔心 領導階層的改變、 不好的名聲，或更大的因素， 比如新法律和貿易政策。

cues.text: And of course, plenty of investors are simply ready to sell valuable stocks
cues.en: And of course, plenty of investors are simply ready to sell valuable stocks
cues.zh: 不好的名聲，或更大的因素， 比如新法律和貿易政策。 當然，許多投資者就只是 準備好要賣掉有價值的股票， 追求個人利益。

cues.text: and pursue personal interests.
cues.en: and pursue personal interests.
cues.zh: 追求個人利益。 所有這些變數每天都會干擾市場，

cues.text: All these variables cause day-to-day noise in the market, which can make companies appear more or less successful.
cues.en: All these variables cause day-to-day noise in the market, which can make companies appear more or less successful.
cues.zh: 所有這些變數每天都會干擾市場， 可能會讓公司看起來 更成功或比較不成功。 在股票市場上，看起來失去價值，

cues.text: And in the stock market, appearing to lose value often leads to losing investors,
cues.en: And in the stock market, appearing to lose value often leads to losing investors,
cues.zh: 在股票市場上，看起來失去價值， 通常會導致失去投資者， 進而真正失去價值。

cues.text: and in turn, losing actual value.
cues.en: and in turn, losing actual value.
cues.zh: 進而真正失去價值。 人類對市場信心的力量很強大，

cues.text: Human confidence in the market has the power to trigger everything from economic booms to financial crises.
cues.en: Human confidence in the market has the power to trigger everything from economic booms to financial crises.
cues.zh: 人類對市場信心的力量很強大， 可以觸發各式各樣的現象， 從經濟繁榮到金融危機。 這個很難追蹤的變數，

cues.text: And this difficult-to-track variable is why most professionals promote reliable long term investing
cues.en: And this difficult-to-track variable is why most professionals promote reliable long term investing
cues.zh: 這個很難追蹤的變數， 正是為什麼專業人士 會推銷可靠的長期投資， 而不是試著快速撈一筆。

cues.text: over trying to make quick cash.
cues.en: over trying to make quick cash.
cues.zh: 而不是試著快速撈一筆。

cues.text: However, experts are constantly building tools in efforts to increase their chances of success
cues.en: However, experts are constantly building tools in efforts to increase their chances of success
cues.zh: 而不是試著快速撈一筆。 然而，專家常常會創造一些工具， 試圖在這個極不可預測的系統中

cues.text: in this highly unpredictable system.
cues.en: in this highly unpredictable system.
cues.zh: 試圖在這個極不可預測的系統中 增加他們的成功機會。

cues.text: But the stock market is not just for the rich and powerful.
cues.en: But the stock market is not just for the rich and powerful.
cues.zh: 增加他們的成功機會。 但，股票市場並非 有錢或有權的人的專利。 隨著網際網路的出現，

cues.text: With the dawn of the Internet, everyday investors can buy stocks in many of the exact same ways a large investor would.
cues.en: With the dawn of the Internet, everyday investors can buy stocks in many of the exact same ways a large investor would.
cues.zh: 隨著網際網路的出現， 一般投資人也可以用許多 大型投資者的方式買賣股票。

cues.text: And as more people educate themselves about this complex system
cues.en: And as more people educate themselves about this complex system
cues.zh: 隨著更多人自學 與這複雜系統相關的知識， 他們也能夠買賣股票， 支援他們所相信的企業，

cues.text: they too can trade stocks, support the businesses they believe in, and pursue their financial goals.
cues.en: they too can trade stocks, support the businesses they believe in, and pursue their financial goals.
cues.zh: 他們也能夠買賣股票， 支援他們所相信的企業， 並追求他們的財務目標。 第一步，就是找到人來投資。

cues.text: The first step is getting invested.
cues.en: The first step is getting invested.
cues.zh: 第一步，就是找到人來投資。
